name: Charlie MJ DevOps Explorer
notes: Learn is now a learning-resource organizer with Add Learning cards
Learning cards can link technologies, bookmarks, favorites, GitHub, YouTube, Medium, LinkedIn, courses, tutorials and official documentation
Technologies includes a dedicated Official Documentation database with multiple docs per technology
Official documentation supports add/edit/delete, import/export JSON and URL health checks
Settings includes Documentation Health controls and repository documentation data-source configuration
Fixed missing Technology catalog handlers for save, render and export actions
Fixed Official Documentation repository URL/path persistence in Settings
Hardened Side Panel opening to avoid Chrome runtime errors and provide a fallback
